name: For a static metric the mixed Einstein components vanish, so T^{0i}=0 (via G_ab = 8 pi T_ab)

published_statement: As READ: the once-normal-once-tangential projection of the Einstein equation is the momentum constraint 8 pi J_i = [div_g(k - (tr k) g)]_i (2409.07639 eq.2.4b, Maxwell term dropped), with J_i = h^b_i n^a T_ab the Eulerian momentum density; a t = const slice of a static metric is time-symmetric initial data, k = 0 (2409.07639 p.15, for its metric), and time-symmetric data carry P = 0 (1110.2087 p.2). Hence for ds^2 = -N^2 dt^2 + h_ij dx^i dx^j with N, h independent of t: J_i = 0, and with zero shift T^{0i} = -E beta^i/N^2 + J^i/N = 0 (beta = 0, J = 0) in these coordinates; equivalently G_{0i} = R_{0i} = 0 identically (re-derived, check B). No published source read here states a converse ('a shift vector forces T^{0i} != 0'); Le 2602.18023 Lemma 2 states the opposite for gradient and rigid-rotation shifts on flat unit-lapse time-independent slices (J = 0).
published_hypotheses: static: a timelike Killing field that is hypersurface-orthogonal, i.e. coordinates exist with g_{0i} = 0 and every g_ab independent of t (restated as time-symmetric slices, k = 0)
the statement T^{0i} = 0 is a COMPONENT statement in those static-adapted coordinates (J_i is defined relative to the normal n of the t-slices)
Einstein's equation G_ab (+ Lambda g_ab) = 8 pi T_ab, to pass from geometry (k = 0) to matter (J = 0); Lambda g_{0i} = 0 so Lambda is harmless
sufficient regularity to define curvature (C^2 metric in the classical statement)

no converse is asserted by any source read: for shifted metrics J vanishes exactly for gradient-plus-rigid-rotation shifts on smooth R^3 with bounded vorticity, flat unit-lapse time-independent slices (Le 2602.18023 Lemma 2)

lacked_data: M's hypothesis does not bite here, in either direction. The result is a mathematical identity about the Levi-Civita connection of a t-independent metric with g_{0i} = 0; it takes no measured input. Checks A and B derive it for arbitrary functions N, h_ij, Phi, so no datum the originators (ADM 1962, textbook GR) lacked can move it; the owner's only numerical inputs (m = 2e-2, one point) do not enter the conclusion (check E). What the audit finds is not missing outside data but the tree's own over-reach: an added converse ('fails automatically for anything with a shift vector', phase1.py:93-94, 535) that is false by shown counterexample (Kerr, flat with shift, gradient shift with j = 0), a component statement read without its adapted-coordinate hypothesis (D5), and a status word ('MEASURED') for a check that cannot fail (E). None of these is an error in the external result.
grade_evidence: The external result STANDS as a theorem: static (hypersurface-orthogonal Killing, g_{0i} = 0, t-independent) => R_{0i} = G_{0i} = 0 => T^{0i} = 0 in adapted coordinates, re-derived symbolically for the general static metric (B) and the owner's ansatz (A), consistent with the momentum constraint READ in 2409.07639 eq.(2.4b). The tree uses it on a larger class than it holds: (1) as an iff -- 'THE STATIC/DYNAMIC SPLIT IS EXACTLY THE TRANSITION/PROPULSION SPLIT' (phase1.py:96, 532-535) and 'fails automatically for anything with a shift vector' (phase1.py:93-94, 255, 535) -- refuted as a universal by shown counterexamples D1, D2, D3 (Kerr: non-static, shift present, T = 0) and D4 (gradient shift: j = 0 exactly); (2) without the adapted-coordinate hypothesis the component statement fails for the very same static geometry (D5: T^{0x} = v T^{00} != 0). The converse clause, taken alone, is WRONG as stated (counterexamples shown here); the keyed forward result is not. The status word 'MEASURED EXACTLY 0.0' is a discrepancy: the numeric check hard-codes d/dt = 0 and a diagonal metric and returns 0.0 for any input (E), so it is structural, not a measurement -- recorded, not repaired. The phase1 Theorem 2 verdict 'static => no momentum' uses only the forward direction and is supported; the classifier's shift-based wording is what narrows.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the tree restricting its use to the forward direction in static-adapted coordinates (drop 'fails automatically / impossible with a shift vector' and 'EXACTLY the split'), i.e. the class the theorem covers; the status word would still read DERIVED rather than MEASURED. To WRONG: a static metric (adapted coordinates, C^2, Einstein's equation) with G_{0i} != 0 -- excluded by check B, which is an identity for arbitrary N, h_ij. Nothing data-dependent could move it. Reading ADM 1962 / Gourgoulhon gr-qc/0703035 at source (quota blocked here) would upgrade read_status to READ without changing the grade.
